For special mention we must include Bert Jordan who pulled off one of his little surprises. Our old friend Mac who finished 40th, is still wondering where Bert popped up from.

Bert Jordan won the 7 miles road race handicap at the Oxted meeting on August Monday. Ian Badiali won the Shipping A.A. 440 yards championship in 52.1 seconds, and Len Rolls won the Veterans A.C. 880 yards championship.

At this stage another second claim member, Jack Braughton, was just ahead of a large group of runners checked in at 29m.10s. which included Eric Gebbett, Len Adams, Ken Stimpson, Bert Jordan, and about another dozen runner.

Jim MacDonald and Bert Jordan, although not at their best, plugged away with typical courage. I was amazed when Mac told me after the race that this was his 8th Poly Marathon, for he still can approach this grind with the excitement and eagerness of a newcomer.
